best_for: Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) founders, brand managers, and e-commerce operators aiming to scale online store revenue profitably.
Digital marketing specialists, performance marketers, and media buyers transitioning into specialized, high-earning e-commerce growth roles.
Shopify merchants and agency growth strategists looking to master feed architecture, full-funnel shopping ads, conversion rate optimization, and retention lifecycles.
target_audience.who_should_take_foundation_first: Learners lacking basic digital marketing, computer, or online business fundamentals should first complete the AI Digital Marketing Specialist program.
not_for: Those looking for passive, theoretical lectures without hands-on Shopify, Google Merchant Center, ad manager, and Klaviyo implementation.
Individuals seeking get-rich-quick dropshipping schemes without sustainable unit economics, product quality, or brand-building principles.

prerequisites.required: Basic digital marketing literacy, familiarity with web browsing, spreadsheets, and commercial business terminology.
prerequisites.recommended: Prior exposure to digital ad platforms (Google Ads or Meta Ads) or basic Shopify/e-commerce store operations.
prerequisites.not_required: Prior coding experience, web development degrees, or personal ad spend budget.

system_requirements.hardware: Standard laptop or desktop PC with 8GB+ RAM, multi-tab browser support, and stable broadband internet connection.
system_requirements.software_accounts: Free tier or partner sandbox access for Shopify, Google Merchant Center, Meta Business Manager, GA4, GTM, and Klaviyo/Brevo.

overview.positioning: Industry-calibrated professional specialization focused on end-to-end e-commerce store architecture, catalog feed integration, full-funnel acquisition, conversion rate optimization, and retention marketing.
overview.short_description: Intensive 4-month specialization mastering Shopify architecture, Google Merchant Center feed diagnostics, Google Shopping & Performance Max campaigns, Meta Advantage+ Catalog ads, PDP conversion optimization, and Klaviyo lifecycle retention with 160 guided training hours.

Configure, troubleshoot, and optimize Google Merchant Center feeds, shipping/tax settings, and Google Product Taxonomy attributes.

why_now.career_opportunity: E-Commerce Growth Specialists command top-tier compensation and high-retainer freelance contracts across global direct-to-consumer and retail markets.

modules.title: E-Commerce Business Models, Unit Economics & Customer Journey
modules.summary: Master the commercial fundamentals of online retail: business models, contribution margin modeling, CAC-to-LTV ratios, and multi-touch customer buying journeys.
modules.why_it_matters: Scaling an e-commerce store without clear unit economics and margin awareness inevitably leads to unprofitable ad spend and cash-flow failure.

lessons.title: E-Commerce Business Models: D2C, B2B, Marketplaces & Hybrid Operations
topics: Comparison of Direct-to-Consumer (D2C), marketplace retail (Amazon, Flipkart), and hybrid multichannel models
Inventory-holding vs. on-demand manufacturing and dropshipping unit economic differences
Private label branding strategies and value chain positioning for sustainable pricing power
learning_objectives: Differentiate core retail business models and identify operational margin trade-offs
Evaluate brand defensibility and margin potential across distinct e-commerce categories

lessons.title: E-Commerce Financials: COGS, Contribution Margins & Profit on Ad Spend (POAS)
topics: Deconstructing the P&L: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS), payment gateway fees, pick-pack-ship costs, and returns
Calculating Contribution Margin 1 (gross), Contribution Margin 2 (post-shipping/packaging), and Contribution Margin 3 (post-ad spend)
Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) limitations vs. Profit on Ad Spend (POAS) and Marketing Efficiency Ratio (MER)
learning_objectives: Build an e-commerce unit economics model in Google Sheets factoring in all fulfillment and marketing expenses
Establish break-even ROAS targets based on category-specific gross and net margins

lessons.title: Customer Economics: AOV, CAC, Customer Lifetime Value & Cohort Retention
topics: Average Order Value (AOV) optimization levers: bundles, thresholds, and cross-sells
Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) blended vs. first-touch calculation and payback period benchmarks
Customer Lifetime Value (LTV) forecasting, 30/60/90-day cohort retention curves, and repeat purchase frequency
learning_objectives: Calculate realistic LTV:CAC ratios and determine sustainable payback periods for funded and bootstrapped brands
Identify early warning signs of cohort decay in customer retention spreadsheets

lessons.title: The Modern E-Commerce Customer Journey: TOFU Discovery to BOFU Loyalty
topics: Omnichannel customer path: social discovery, search intent, remarketing touchpoints, and email reactivation
Micro-conversions across the buying funnel: product impressions, clicks, cart adds, and checkout initiations
Mapping post-purchase touchpoints: transactional alerts, unboxing experience, review requests, and referral triggers
learning_objectives: Map an end-to-end e-commerce customer buying journey across paid, owned, and earned media touchpoints
Identify friction drop-off points between top-of-funnel browsing and bottom-of-funnel checkout completion

student_lab_tasks: Construct a detailed E-Commerce Unit Economics & Margin Calculator in Google Sheets for a simulated fashion/beauty D2C brand.
Calculate break-even ROAS, Contribution Margin 2, and 60-day customer cohort payback periods using provided SKU sales data.
measurable_outcomes: Completed and verified Google Sheets financial model accurately calculating gross margin, CM1/CM2/CM3, break-even ROAS, and blended MER.
Written executive summary analyzing the commercial viability of a sample D2C brand's pricing and marketing spend.

modules.title: Shopify Store Architecture, Product Merchandising & Conversion Design
modules.summary: Build and optimize high-converting Shopify online stores with modular architecture, intuitive navigation, persuasive product pages, and mobile-first UX.
modules.why_it_matters: Even world-class ad traffic cannot generate profitable returns if the destination store creates cognitive friction, slow load times, or confusing checkout paths.

lessons.title: Shopify Platform Architecture: Themes, Navigation & Taxonomy
topics: Shopify 2.0 theme architecture: sections everywhere, blocks, and dynamic JSON templates
Information architecture: multi-level dropdowns, collection grouping, and intuitive mobile drawer menus
Product catalog data modeling: vendor, product types, tags, variants, and custom metafields
learning_objectives: Configure a high-performance Shopify development store with structured collection and navigation taxonomy
Leverage Shopify metafields to display dynamic product specifications and trust badges

lessons.title: High-Converting Product Detail Page (PDP) Architecture
topics: Anatomy of a high-converting PDP: media gallery, scannable value propositions, sticky add-to-cart, and payment badges
Social proof integration: review ratings, verified customer photos, and press trust badges
Accordion content structuring: shipping timelines, ingredients/materials, sizing charts, and FAQ accordions
learning_objectives: Wireframe and implement an industry-standard PDP layout that minimizes cognitive load and maximizes cart additions
Configure high-impact trust signals and social proof widgets to alleviate buyer hesitation

lessons.title: Merchandising Strategies: Bundling, Upsells & Free Shipping Thresholds
topics: Strategic product bundling: fixed bundles, build-your-own-box (BYOB), and volume discounts (Buy 2 Get 10% Off)
In-cart and pre-checkout cross-selling: complementary accessories and impulse buy widgets
Progressive free shipping progress bars and tiered cart reward bars to lift Average Order Value (AOV)
learning_objectives: Design and implement bundle and tiered discount offers in Shopify to lift AOV by at least 15-25%
Configure dynamic cart drawer upsells that activate based on cart total and items present

lessons.title: Essential Shopify App Stack & Performance Evaluation
topics: Curating the essential app stack: reviews (Judge.me/Loox), upsells, back-in-stock alerts, and shipping trackers
App bloat diagnosis: evaluating third-party script impact on JavaScript execution and Core Web Vitals
Zero-code customization vs. app overhead: weighing theme-native features against external plugins
learning_objectives: Audit an existing Shopify app ecosystem to eliminate redundant scripts and improve page speed
Select, install, and configure compliant customer review and merchandising apps

lessons.title: Mobile-First E-Commerce UX & Speed Benchmarking
topics: Mobile design standards: 48px touch targets, sticky bottom action bar, and thumb-zone optimization
Core Web Vitals for e-commerce: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP), Interaction to Next Paint (INP), and Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)
Image optimization protocols: WebP conversion, responsive image sizing, and lazy-loading non-critical assets
learning_objectives: Perform mobile UX audits and implement sticky add-to-cart buttons for seamless handheld checkout
Diagnose and remediate Core Web Vitals bottlenecks on desktop and mobile Shopify viewports

student_lab_tasks: Set up a live Shopify Partner Development Store for a chosen retail brand with 10+ configured products across 3 collections.
Build a fully customized PDP featuring image carousels, dynamic metafield specifications, review widgets, and a free shipping threshold progress bar.
measurable_outcomes: Published Shopify Sandbox Store URL with verified navigation, responsive PDP, working cart drawer, and mobile-optimized checkout path.
Shopify Store Audit and UX scorecard document evaluating mobile usability against 20 e-commerce UX heuristics.

modules.title: Google Merchant Center Architecture, Feed Optimization & Diagnostics
modules.summary: Master Google Merchant Center (GMC) setup, product feed data engineering, title formulas, attribute mapping, and troubleshooting account/policy disapprovals.
modules.why_it_matters: Google Shopping and Performance Max campaigns rely 100% on feed quality; poor feed architecture causes product disapprovals, high CPCs, and lost ad visibility.

lessons.title: GMC Setup, Account Architecture & Domain Verification
topics: GMC account structure: individual accounts vs. Advanced Multi-Client Accounts (MCA) for agencies
Website domain claiming and verification via HTML tag, DNS record, and Google Tag Manager
Store policies compliance: refund policy, delivery terms, payment methods, and contact info requirements
learning_objectives: Complete end-to-end GMC account setup, business verification, and domain claiming without compliance warnings
Verify e-commerce store policy pages against Google Shopping policy guidelines to prevent account suspension

lessons.title: Product Feed Architecture: Primary vs. Supplemental Feeds
topics: Feed delivery methods: Google Content API (Shopify direct sync), scheduled XML/TSV fetches, and Google Sheets feeds
Primary feed configuration: baseline product attributes (id, title, description, link, image_link, price, availability)
Supplemental feeds: using supplemental sheets to overwrite attributes, add custom labels, and test promotional titles without touching the primary store catalog
learning_objectives: Construct and connect primary and supplemental product feeds in GMC using TSV and Google Sheets
Use supplemental feeds to apply custom label segmentation (e.g., High Margin, Best Seller, Seasonal)

lessons.title: Critical Feed Attributes & Title Optimization Engineering
topics: Title optimization formulas by category: [Brand + Gender + Product Type + Color + Size/Material]
Google Product Taxonomy mapping: choosing the deepest valid category IDs for maximum query relevance
Unique product identifiers: Global Trade Item Numbers (GTIN/UPC/EAN), Manufacturer Part Numbers (MPN), and identifier_exists flags
Rich product descriptions, high-resolution lifestyle secondary images, and additional_image_link hygiene
learning_objectives: Rewrite and optimize product titles to capture high-intent shopping queries within 150-character limits
Correctly assign Google Product Taxonomy IDs and resolve missing GTIN/identifier compliance errors

lessons.title: GMC Diagnostics, Policy Violations & Error Remediation
topics: Navigating GMC Diagnostics: account-level, feed-level, and item-level issues
Resolving common item disapprovals: price mismatch, currency inconsistency, landing page unavailable, and promotional text in images
Handling account suspensions: misrepresentation, untrustworthy promotions, and the formal appeal submission process
learning_objectives: Diagnose and systematically resolve critical feed errors using GMC error logs and validation reports
Author professional suspension appeal documentation with evidence of website and business policy compliance

lessons.title: Shipping, Taxes & Regional Feed Settings
topics: Configuring shipping rate tables in GMC: flat rates, weight-based rates, carrier-calculated rates, and transit time transit zones
Regional tax settings and GST/sales tax configuration by shipping zone
Configuring Merchant Center Promotions: % off, fixed discount, free shipping codes, and sale price annotations
learning_objectives: Build accurate multi-tier shipping and tax rules in GMC that exactly match store checkout calculations
Set up Merchant Promotions that display promotional badges and strike-through pricing on Google Shopping ads

student_lab_tasks: Audit a 50-SKU e-commerce product feed dataset containing intentional formatting, attribute, and policy violations.
Engineer an optimized product feed spreadsheet with structured title formulas, mapped taxonomy, and custom labels (0-4).
measurable_outcomes: Clean, fully validated 50-SKU product feed (TSV/Sheets) passing all Google Merchant Center feed validation checks with zero critical errors.
Feed Optimization & Error Resolution Matrix documenting before/after titles, mapped taxonomy, and policy remediation actions.

modules.title: E-Commerce SEO, Category Architecture & Generative Search Visibility
modules.summary: Master technical and on-page SEO tailored specifically to e-commerce catalogs: faceted navigation, collection page ranking, structured data, and AI-driven search engines.
modules.why_it_matters: Organic search delivers high-intent shoppers with zero incremental ad cost; mastering e-commerce SEO builds defensible, compounding revenue for online brands.

lessons.title: Technical E-Commerce SEO: Faceted Navigation & Crawl Efficiency
topics: Faceted search and filter parameters: managing color, size, and price URL parameters to prevent index bloat
Canonicalization strategy: self-referential canonicals, parameterized variants pointing to master products, and canonical loops
Pagination architecture: rel=next/prev legacy vs. single-view collections, XML sitemaps, and crawl budget preservation
learning_objectives: Audit e-commerce site crawling using Screaming Frog to identify duplicate content caused by faceted filters
Formulate robust robots.txt and canonicalization rules to guide search bot indexing efficiently

lessons.title: Category & Collection Page SEO: Keyword Intent Mapping
topics: Commercial vs. transactional search intent: optimizing category headers and bottom-of-page content blocks
Internal linking silos: linking parent categories, child collections, and popular product tags
Product title conventions and URL slug hygiene for category ranking power
learning_objectives: Map high-volume commercial keywords to parent and child collection pages without keyword cannibalization
Author engaging collection page copy that ranks organically while enhancing human shopper conversion

lessons.title: Product Page Schema.org & Rich Snippets Integration
topics: Product and Offer structured data JSON-LD: name, image, description, sku, mpn, price, priceCurrency, availability
AggregateRating and Review schema: displaying star ratings and review counts directly in Google organic search results
MerchantReturnPolicy and ShippingDetails schema: displaying free returns and fast delivery badges in search snippets
learning_objectives: Write and validate complete Schema.org Product, Offer, and AggregateRating JSON-LD scripts
Verify rich result eligibility using Google's Rich Results Test tool

lessons.title: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) for E-Commerce Catalogs
topics: How Google AI Overviews and conversational engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT Search) source and cite product recommendations
Optimizing for entity recognition: brand mentions, authoritative product comparison inclusions, and Reddit/forum citations
Structuring FAQ blocks and comparison matrices to win conversational recommendation visibility
learning_objectives: Optimize e-commerce product and category content for citation in AI-generated search overviews and shopping recommendations
Benchmark brand visibility across AI search engines for competitive commercial queries

student_lab_tasks: Perform a full technical SEO crawl of a sandbox e-commerce catalog using Screaming Frog to identify indexation and canonical issues.
Draft and validate Product, Offer, Review, and MerchantReturn JSON-LD structured data for 3 distinct product catalog items.
measurable_outcomes: E-Commerce SEO Technical Architecture Document outlining faceted navigation rules, canonical strategy, and XML sitemap hierarchy.
Error-free Schema.org JSON-LD scripts validated through Google's Rich Results Test with verified rich snippet preview.

modules.title: Google Ads for E-Commerce: Shopping, Performance Max & Demand Gen
modules.summary: Master profitable paid acquisition on Google: conversion value tracking, Standard Shopping priority sculpting, Performance Max asset groups, Demand Gen, and value bidding.
modules.why_it_matters: Google Shopping and Performance Max represent the largest source of high-intent paid revenue for online retail; strategic campaign setup determines profitability.

lessons.title: Google Ads E-Commerce Conversion Infrastructure & Enhanced Conversions
topics: E-commerce conversion tracking: setting up purchase key events, transaction IDs, dynamic order revenue, and currency
Enhanced Conversions for Web: hashing first-party customer data (email, phone, address) to restore lost attribution
Value-based conversion tracking vs. count-based tracking and secondary conversion goal designation
learning_objectives: Configure dynamic transaction value and Enhanced Conversions tracking in Google Ads via GTM
Verify conversion tracking health and ensure zero duplicate transactions are recorded

lessons.title: Standard Shopping Campaigns: Priority Tiering & Query Sculpting
topics: Three-tier campaign priority structure: High, Medium, and Low campaign priority mechanics with shared budgets
Negative keyword sculpting: forcing generic, brand, and product-specific queries into appropriate priority campaigns
Product group subdivision by category, custom label, and product type for granular bid management
learning_objectives: Architect a 3-tier Standard Shopping campaign structure isolating high-intent search terms from expensive generic queries
Apply negative keyword lists to sculpt shopping query flow and protect ad spend

lessons.title: Performance Max (PMax) Deep-Dive: Campaign Setup & Asset Groups
topics: Performance Max architecture: cross-network reach across Search, Shopping, YouTube, Display, Discover, and Maps
Asset Group organization: structuring asset groups by product category rather than mixing unrelated catalog items
Asset requirements: headlines (short/long), descriptions, high-res lifestyle images, logos, and YouTube video integration
Audience Signals: uploading first-party customer lists, website remarketing lists, custom search intent segments, and competitor URL themes
learning_objectives: Build complete Performance Max campaigns with segmented Asset Groups mapped to specific product collections
Construct powerful Audience Signals utilizing first-party customer data and high-intent search themes

lessons.title: PMax Optimization: Asset Hygiene, Exclusions & Script Monitoring
topics: Evaluating Asset Performance ratings (Low, Good, Best) and systematic asset refresh cycles
Brand exclusions and negative keywords at the account and campaign level to prevent cannibalizing organic brand traffic
Using Google Ads scripts to extract Search vs. Shopping vs. Video/Display channel spend breakdowns from PMax black boxes
Final URL Expansion settings and URL exclusion rules to prevent traffic driving to irrelevant blog pages
learning_objectives: Audit PMax asset performance and replace underperforming creative elements systematically
Apply brand lists, placement exclusions, and URL rules to ensure PMax budget drives incremental, high-margin sales

lessons.title: Demand Gen Campaigns for E-Commerce Visual Discovery
topics: Demand Gen fundamentals: engaging mid-funnel shoppers across YouTube Shorts, Discover Feed, and Gmail
Product feed integration in Demand Gen: displaying interactive shopping carousels below immersive video ads
Lookalike segments and seed audience creation based on high-value repeat customer lists
learning_objectives: Build Demand Gen campaigns combining visual video storytelling with dynamic catalog product cards
Configure lookalike audiences to scale prospecting beyond bottom-of-funnel search intent

lessons.title: Value-Based Bidding & Profit-Driven Budget Pacing
topics: Bidding algorithms: Maximize Conversion Value vs. Target ROAS (tROAS) constraints
Bid strategy learning phases, budget pacing rules, and managing seasonal volatility (holidays, sales events)
Aligning tROAS targets with Contribution Margin 2 and inventory stock levels
learning_objectives: Calculate mathematically sound tROAS targets based on gross margins and customer acquisition targets
Manage bid adjustments and budget scaling without throwing machine learning algorithms into volatile reset states

student_lab_tasks: In Google Ads draft/editor sandbox, construct a complete 3-tier Standard Shopping campaign structure with negative keyword sculpting.
Build a Performance Max campaign blueprint with 2 distinct Asset Groups, complete copy decks, image asset matrices, and audience signals.
measurable_outcomes: Exported Google Ads campaign architecture workbook (.csv/.xlsx) specifying campaigns, ad groups, negative lists, and bidding rules.
Performance Max Asset Matrix detailing all headlines, descriptions, creative specs, and audience signal inputs ready for client deployment.

modules.title: Meta Ads for E-Commerce: Catalog Ads, Advantage+ & Creative Iteration
modules.summary: Master paid social customer acquisition: Meta Commerce Manager catalogs, Dynamic Product Ads (DPA/DABA), Advantage+ Shopping Campaigns (ASC), and creative iteration.
modules.why_it_matters: Meta is the primary discovery engine for direct-to-consumer e-commerce; success requires uniting dynamic catalog feeds with structured creative testing.

lessons.title: Meta Commerce Manager, Catalog Feeds & Event Pairing
topics: Setting up Meta Commerce Manager: catalogs, data feeds, and scheduled automatic sync from Shopify
Pixel and Conversions API (CAPI) pairing: ensuring high Event Match Quality (EMQ 8.0+) for ViewContent, AddToCart, and Purchase
Product Sets: creating segmented catalog groups by collection, price point, margin, and seasonality for targeted campaigns
learning_objectives: Connect and verify an e-commerce catalog in Meta Commerce Manager with verified CAPI event pairing
Create filtered Product Sets to power targeted dynamic ads for specific inventory collections

lessons.title: Dynamic Ads for E-Commerce: DABA Prospecting & DPA Retargeting
topics: Dynamic Ads for Broad Audiences (DABA): reaching new prospective shoppers with personalized catalog recommendations
Dynamic Product Ads (DPA) retargeting: setting up 7-day, 14-day, and 30-day view/cart abandonment retargeting windows
Catalog card customization: adding dynamic price tags, discount badges, and branded frame overlays in Ads Manager
learning_objectives: Structure DABA prospecting and DPA retargeting campaigns with granular audience exclusions
Design branded catalog card templates displaying dynamic strikethrough pricing and promotional badges

lessons.title: Advantage+ Shopping Campaigns (ASC) Strategy & Customer Caps
topics: Advantage+ Shopping Campaign mechanics: automated machine learning optimization across placements, creatives, and audiences
Account-level existing customer definition and setting existing customer budget caps (10-20%) to ensure new customer acquisition
Managing creative fatigue in ASC: monitoring frequency, creative distribution, and first-time impression ratios

faq.question: Who is the E-Commerce & Growth Marketing Specialist program designed for?
faq.answer: This course is specifically engineered for D2C founders, Shopify store owners, performance marketers, digital marketing professionals, agency growth managers, and freelancers who want to specialize in high-growth online retail marketing.

faq.question: What are the prerequisites for this course?
faq.answer: Learners should have basic digital marketing literacy, familiarity with web browsing, spreadsheets, and commercial business terminology. Prior exposure to Google Ads, Meta Ads, or basic store operations is helpful but not required. No coding or web development experience is necessary.

faq.question: How is this course different from the AI Digital Marketing Specialist and AI Digital Marketing Strategist programs?
faq.answer: The AI Digital Marketing Specialist (3 Months, 120h, ₹24,900) is a foundational execution program covering general SEO, social, and search ads. The AI Digital Marketing Strategist (6 Months, 240h, ₹44,900) is an executive career mastery in enterprise omnichannel strategy, technical SEO/GEO, and marketing automation. The E-Commerce & Growth Marketing Specialist (4 Months, 160h, ₹34,900) is an intensive, specialized vertical program focused 100% on online retail: Shopify store architecture, Google Merchant Center feed diagnostics, Google Shopping & PMax, Meta Advantage+ Catalog ads, CRO, Klaviyo retention, and e-commerce unit economics.

faq.question: What is the total duration and guided training hours?
faq.answer: The program spans 4 Months (16 Weeks) comprising exactly 160 guided training hours led by industry instructors, plus an estimated 60-80 recommended hours for independent store building, feed diagnostics, and project development.

faq.question: What is the fee structure for the E-Commerce & Growth Marketing Specialist program?
faq.answer: The total tuition fee is ₹34,900 INR (taxes/GST extra where applicable). Flexible monthly EMI options are available to make enrollment accessible.

faq.question: Do students need an active paid Shopify subscription or advertising budget to participate?
faq.answer: No. All hands-on training is conducted using free Shopify Partner development stores, sandbox accounts, Google Merchant Center test environments, draft-mode ad managers, and platform sandbox environments. Students do not need personal ad spend or paid store subscriptions.

faq.question: Will students work on real-world e-commerce stores and datasets?
faq.answer: Yes. Students audit and build real sandbox stores, optimize 50+ SKU product feeds, troubleshoot simulated Merchant Center policy disapprovals, analyze real e-commerce GA4 and Google Ads datasets, and build live Looker Studio dashboards.

faq.question: Which specific e-commerce platforms and ad networks are covered in depth?
faq.answer: Primary platforms covered include Shopify, Google Merchant Center, Google Ads (Standard Shopping, Performance Max, Demand Gen), Meta Ads Manager (Commerce Manager, Advantage+ Catalog Ads), Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Klaviyo, Brevo, and Microsoft Clarity.

faq.question: How is Google Merchant Center and Product Feed training delivered?
faq.answer: Students learn end-to-end feed architecture: primary vs. supplemental feeds, Google Product Taxonomy, structured title engineering, attribute compliance (GTIN, MPN, brand), shipping/tax rules, and diagnostic error remediation for account disapprovals.

faq.question: What kind of retention marketing and lifecycle automation will I learn?
faq.answer: You will master e-commerce retention using Klaviyo and Brevo: Welcome Series, Abandoned Cart/Checkout recovery, Post-Purchase upsells, Customer Winback, RFM customer segmentation, and compliance-first SMS marketing.

faq.question: How does AI fit into this e-commerce curriculum?
faq.answer: AI is integrated throughout: using AI for product catalog enrichment, generating compelling product descriptions, creating multi-angle direct response ad copy, designing visual ad creatives and video storyboards, and conducting competitor intelligence.

faq.question: What portfolio deliverables and capstone projects will I complete?
faq.answer: You will complete 8 comprehensive portfolio assets, culminating in a 90-Day Full-Funnel E-Commerce Growth Strategy and client pitch deck that demonstrates end-to-end store optimization, ad architecture, and retention capability.

faq.question: Does Nova Skills guarantee job placement or e-commerce revenue upon graduation?
faq.answer: Nova Skills provides dedicated placement support, portfolio defense training, resume engineering, and interview preparation, but does NOT make false or deceptive job or revenue guarantees. Success depends on the learner's skill execution and market performance.

faq.question: What career paths and freelance opportunities does this specialization unlock?
faq.answer: Graduates qualify for high-demand roles including E-Commerce Growth Specialist, D2C Growth Manager, Shopify Marketing Lead, Performance Marketing Specialist (E-Com), Retention Marketing Manager, or independent e-commerce growth consulting/agency services.
